Grave Wounds Field Map

Battles of hundreds: the rank and file fight as units, a minute an exchange, each hex 10 m. Set up the units, then each exchange side A moves, side B moves, and every fight and volley is resolved together through the wound tables. Morale decides most fights; the rout does most of the killing.

Wound rollerTeam builderTravel mapStart page

The field

Each unit is a block of hexes along its front (the dark edge), facing the arrow. Close order holds 40 men a hex, open order 20. Units touching across a front fight; archers shoot at the nearest enemy in range in front of them.

        Fire support

        Off-map artillery and mortars on call. On its side's move, pick a battery, Call fire, then click a hex one of the side's units can see. Field guns and howitzers land the next exchange, mortars this one; each shell scatters. A battery that has fired is located (◉): the other side's guns can fire on it (Counter-battery) with no one needing to see it, knocking out tubes and killing and wounding crews (a tube without enough men falls silent). Displace moves it: silent for an exchange or more, then no longer located. Smoke drifts with the wind.

          Heroes

          Named fighters from the wound roller can join a unit: in its front rank, shooting with it, or behind it. They fight with their own skill, and their wounds go back to the roller.

            Add a unit

            During the battle the side to move can bring on a unit (from its forces' reserves, when the battle came from the travel map). It comes on at that side's back edge and can move next exchange.
